newsitem.title: UGANDA: UGANDA SHILLING GAINS SLIGHTLY ON DOLLAR, POUND.
newsitem.headline: UGANDA SHILLING GAINS SLIGHTLY ON DOLLAR, POUND.

text.p: The Uganda shilling strengthened marginally against both the dollar and sterling pound, currency dealers said on Friday.
Commercial forex dealers posted the shilling at a commercial average of 1,085 against the dollar compared to 1,087.5 on Thursday.
Against the pound, the shilling was posted at a commercial mean of 1,715 from 1,735.
"There was a slight decline in demand for them (dollars)," said a dealer in one of Kampala's foreign exchange shops.
